title: Crop PDF Margins — Trim White Spaces Online
h1: Crop White Margins from PDF Pages
description: Remove annoying white margins from your PDF documents for a better reading experience on mobile devices and e-readers. 100% free and local.

sections.title: Why Crop PDF Margins?
sections.content: Many academic papers and ebooks have huge white margins. Cropping them makes text larger and easier to read on smaller screens.

steps.title: Upload File
steps.description: Drop your PDF into the browser sandbox.

steps.title: Set Margins
steps.description: Define the bounding box by dragging the handles.

steps.title: Crop PDF
steps.description: Hit crop and download the trimmed file instantly.

sections.title: Secure Margin Removal
sections.content: No need to upload your sensitive PDFs just to remove some whitespace. Our WebAssembly engine does it in your browser.
sections.subTitle: Zero Upload Policy
sections.subContent: Your files never leave your device.

sections.title: 100% Offline Cropping
sections.content: Your files never leave your computer. Perfect for confidential legal or medical documents.

sections.title: Instant PDF Trimming
sections.content: Trim a 500-page book in milliseconds without waiting for server uploads or downloads.
